import json,subprocess,pathlib,hashlib,tomllib,os
root=pathlib.Path('/home/bench/.codex')
files={}
for f in ['config.toml','deepseek-v4-pro.config.toml','model-catalogs/deepseek-v4-pro/models.json']:
 b=(root/f).read_bytes();files[f]=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
c=tomllib.loads((root/'config.toml').read_text());p=tomllib.loads((root/'deepseek-v4-pro.config.toml').read_text());m=json.loads(pathlib.Path(p['model_catalog_json']).read_text())
assert not set(c).intersection(p)
assert c['features']['multi_agent'] is False and c['web_search']=='disabled' and c['sandbox_workspace_write']['network_access'] is False
assert p['model']=='deepseek-v4-pro' and p['model_reasoning_effort']=='high' and p['model_provider']=='deepseek'
assert p['model_providers']['deepseek']['env_key']=='DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'
assert len(m['models'])==1 and m['models'][0]['slug']==p['model']
assert not any(k in os.environ for k in ['OPENAI_API_KEY','DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'])
out={'file_sha256':files,'static_config_assertions':'PASS','credentials_present':False,'commands':[]}
def run(argv,omit=False):
 try:
  r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
  entry={'argv':argv,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stderr':r.stderr}
  if omit:
   entry['stdout_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(r.stdout.encode()).hexdigest()
   entry['stdout_bytes']=len(r.stdout.encode())
   if r.returncode==0:entry['json_items']=len(json.loads(r.stdout))
  else:entry['stdout']=r.stdout
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
  entry={'argv':argv,'exit_code':None,'timeout_seconds':20,'stderr':str(e)}
 out['commands'].append(entry);return entry
run(['codex','--version'])
prompt=run(['codex','--profile','deepseek-v4-pro','debug','prompt-input','Offline configuration audit only.'],True)
sandbox=run(['codex','--profile','deepseek-v4-pro','sandbox','linux','--','/bin/true'])
out['profile_load']='PASS' if prompt['exit_code']==0 else 'FAIL'
out['sandbox_startup']='PASS' if sandbox['exit_code']==0 else 'FAIL'
out['sandbox_write_and_network_enforcement']='NOT_TESTED: sandbox startup failed' if sandbox['exit_code']!=0 else 'NOT_TESTED'
out['system_bwrap_on_path']=subprocess.run(['sh','-c','command -v bwrap'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip() or None
freeze=subprocess.run(['python','-m','pip','freeze','--all'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
out['python_dependency_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(('\n'.join(sorted(freeze.splitlines()))+'\n').encode()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps(out))
